medium: hand-authored HTML, captured in browser. No image generation on this machine, so the comp is the real composition rather than a render of one.
prompt: Review queue as a shift register. Same four regions. The board becomes a single dense column of full width rows, four fixed columns per row: a 104px tag plate carrying status, confidence and tier; the spoken quote with reporter and time; the matched activity with margin and the reason it is held; a fixed action stack. Keyboard hint bar and bulk threshold sit above the rows with the threshold drawn as a graticule. Rows alternate ground, the selected row takes a hi-vis left edge.
varies: Density and repetition. Actions land in the same place every row so a planner clearing forty does not re-aim.
